name: Pangolin
overview: Reach private resources on a Pangolin network (e.g. an LDAPS server)
description: Runs the Pangolin CLI as a machine client alongside Jellyfin, so the server can reach Pangolin private resources such as an LDAP server for the LDAP Authentication plugin. Supervises the tunnel, shows peer status, and can test TCP/TLS reachability of a resource.

versions.changelog: Explain up front when Jellyfin isn't running as root or sudo is missing (e.g. the linuxserver.io image) instead of failing or retrying.
